BrochureContent.Content:
Kennedy Estate Agents present this exceptional, split-level property offering magnificent sea views overlooking Cork Harbour, East Ferry and Cobh. This meticulously maintained, 4 bedroom detached family home is located in the highly desirable area of Lower Aghada in East Cork. Residents appreciate the quality of life available with coastal walks, numerous activities for families and a choice of sandy beaches within close proximity. 
On arrival, the sweeping driveway ensures complete privacy and leads to the double garage with potential for a self-contained living unit subject to planning permission. 
From the moment you enter the home, the spectacular sea views are abundantly clear. The rear garden is private and benefits from a superb garden room / home gym which would make a fantastic office for those of us working from home.
The People's Path is located a 5 minute walk away from the property offering a 5 kilometre shoreline walkway. This walkway provides access to Aghada Village- home to Rosie's Bar & Restaurant and Aghada Pier offering a choice of water activities. The People's Path concludes in Whitegate Village, which offers a Eurospar, National School, Playground, and Corkbeg Coffee- a unique shipping container positioned on the water's edge. 
This home truly needs to be viewed to appreciate all that is on offer. 

Location: 
The Rostellan, Aghada, Whitegate area is known for its active community with Aghada Tennis Club, Aghada GAA Club, Whitegate Rowing Club and Corkbeg Pitch and Putt all within close proximity. Midleton Town is located approximately 12 minutes' drive away offering all social and essential amenities such as schools, shops, bars, restaurants and frequent rail links to Cork City. 

Distance:
Midleton- 12 minutes' drive / 10 kilometres
Cork City- 30 minutes' drive / 29 kilometres
Cork Airport- 34 minutes' drive / 38 kilometres

Generous, formal room with impressive “Le Droff” open fireplace and magnificent sea views overlooking Cork Harbour. Feature arched double doors.

Karndean flooring, “Le Droff” open fireplace and feature arched double doors leading to kitchen. Adaptable room which would make an ideal play room for young families.

Bedroom 1:
Generous double room with carpet flooring and spectacular sea views. 
Ensuite:
Jack & Jill shower room with WC, wash hand basin and power shower. Fully tiled. 

Solid wood staircase leading down to additional bedroom accommodation:
Bedroom 2: 
Carpet flooring, built-in Sliderobes, sea views. 
Bedroom 3: 
Carpet flooring, built-in wardrobes, sea views. 
Bedroom 4:
Carpet flooring, built-in wardrobes, sea views. 
Bathroom:
WC, wash hand basin, bath and separate walk-in electric shower. 
Office:
Office / storage room with carpet flooring. 

Garden Room:
Magnificent garden room with sea views and decking area to front. Currently being used as a dining area & gym. Would make an ideal home office or studio.
